name: Whelkspire
lore: It drills the shell of anything slower than itself, which is most things. It takes a whole day and it does not hurry.
prompt: Large knobbed whelk shell carried on a thick muscular grey foot, the spire chalk-white and drilled with old boreholes, a horny brown operculum hanging beside the mouth like a shield and two short eye stalks out over the rim
